positions.label: Baron & Mist
tips: Nothing here closes. Buy a few Potions and Phoenix Downs; the first real spike is the Antlion.

positions.label: Kaipo & the Waterway
tips: Tellah joins as a guest. In the older 2D versions his gear leaves with him later — nothing to do yet, just remember it.

positions.label: Damcyan & the Antlion
tips: Edward joins here and leaves at Fabul's boat. His harps are worthless, his armor slots are not.

positions.label: Mt. Hobs & Fabul
tips: Before boarding the boat: strip Rydia and Edward. Kain leaves after the crystal battle — strip him too if you are on an older 2D version.
3D versions: hand departing characters their Augments before they go; they give some back when they return or leave for good.

positions.label: Mysidia & Mt. Ordeals
tips: Cecil's Dark Knight gear is gone once he becomes a Paladin; sell or unequip what you can first. Palom and Porom join here.

positions.label: Baron Liberation
tips: Palom and Porom petrify themselves in the castle. Strip their gear (and give Augments in 3D) before the wall trap.
Yang rejoins in the castle; Cid and the airship come with the liberation.

positions.label: Troia & the Dark Elf
tips: Edward is bedridden in Troia's castle — visit him for the Twin Harp before the Dark Elf. Metal gear is useless in the magnetic cave; pack bows, harps and claws.

positions.label: Tower of Zot
tips: The tower vanishes afterward: open every chest on the climb. Strip Tellah before the top-floor scenes.

positions.label: Dwarven Castle
tips: Rydia returns grown up with her own gear. The Feymarch and the Sylvan Cave open once the story moves on — both are permanent.

positions.label: Tower of Babil
tips: Two departures in one beat: Yang stays with the cannons, Cid jumps with the bomb. Strip both before the cutscenes chain.

positions.label: Cave of Eblan & Upper Babil
tips: Everything above the Eblan crossing is one-visit-only — the cannon floors collapse behind you. Edge joins for good.

positions.label: The Sealed Cave
tips: The underworld's side content is open: the Feymarch (Asura, Leviathan, Rat Tail), the Sylvan Cave (Sylph, Frying Pan), Kokkol's forge. None of it closes.

positions.label: The Big Whale
tips: The hovercraft rides inside the whale: Adamant Isle's tail collector (Rat Tail → Adamantite) and Baron's Odin are reachable now.

positions.label: The Moon — Lair of the Father
tips: Bahamut's cave is open the moment you land. Count his Mega Flare timer and mirror it with Reflect.

positions.label: The Giant of Babil
tips: The Giant is destroyed when you win — sweep its chests. FuSoYa leaves right after: strip him (and hand over Augments in 3D) before the fight.

positions.label: Lunar Subterrane
tips: Every legendary chest is guarded. The Pink Tail grind (Flan Princesses, B5 alcove) is the last big optional detour.

positions.label: The Final Descent
tips: Dark Matter is stolen from Zeromus itself in the versions that allow it. Nothing else closes.

items.name: Strip Rydia's gear
items.location: Before boarding the boat at Fabul

route.why: Leviathan takes her — unequip everything before sailing

items.notes: Older 2D versions lose departing characters' equipment forever; Pixel Remaster refunds it. Cheap insurance either way.

items.name: Strip Edward's gear
items.location: Before boarding the boat at Fabul

route.why: He washes ashore alone — take his equipment first

items.notes: Same boat, same storm. His Harps aren't worth much, but his armor slots are.

items.name: Strip Kain's gear

route.why: He walks out with Golbez after the fight

items.notes: Most versions hand his gear back when he rejoins at Zot — verify on yours. Unequipping costs a minute; being wrong costs a Blood Lance.

items.name: Strip Palom & Porom's gear
items.location: Baron Castle — before the closing-wall trap

route.why: They petrify themselves to hold the walls — their gear turns to stone with them

items.notes: Unequip both twins before Baigan and the throne room. They return much later in some versions, without what they were wearing.

items.name: Strip Tellah's gear
items.location: Tower of Zot — before the confrontation

route.why: The sage does not come back down the tower

items.notes: Unequip him before the top-floor scenes.

items.name: Strip Yang's gear
items.location: Tower of Babil — before the escape

route.why: He stays behind with the cannons

items.notes: His claws travel with him unless you take them first.

items.name: Strip Cid's gear
items.location: The airship escape from the underworld

route.why: He jumps with the bomb right after Yang's farewell

items.notes: Two departures in one beat — check both before the cutscenes chain.

items.name: Strip FuSoYa's gear

route.why: He returns to the moon's core once the Giant falls

items.notes: Unequip him before the CPU fight ends.

items.name: Augment hand-offs (3D)
items.location: Every departing character, before they leave
steps: Rydia and Edward — before the Fabul boat
Palom & Porom — before Baron's wall trap
Tellah — before the top of Zot
Yang and Cid — before the Babil escape
FuSoYa — before the Giant of Babil falls
items.notes: The 3D remake's Augment system: characters who leave give back Augments based on what they carried. Two Augments handed to Tellah, Yang or Cid come back as their signature abilities.

items.name: Twin Harp

route.why: Edward's harp breaks the Dark Elf's magnetic field — story-required, but easy to walk past

items.notes: Visit Edward in the castle before the Lodestone Cavern; without the harp the Dark Elf fight cannot be finished.

items.name: Tower of Zot sweep

route.why: The tower vanishes from the world map afterward

items.notes: Open every chest on the climb — there is no second visit.

items.name: Upper Babil sweep

route.why: The cannon floors collapse behind you

items.notes: Everything above the Eblan crossing is one-visit-only.

items.name: Giant of Babil sweep

route.why: The Giant is destroyed when you win

items.notes: The chests inside go down with it.

items.name: Sylph (and the Frying Pan)
steps: Find Yang asleep in the Sylvan Cave
Fetch the Frying Pan from his wife in Fabul
Wake him with it — Rydia learns Sylph at his bedside
Return the pan to Fabul for the Knife
items.notes: Four trips for one summon and one dagger. The cave's floor traps hurt; bring Float or walk the safe tiles.

items.name: Asura

route.why: The queen's test — Reflect trivializes her healing

items.notes: Rydia only. The Feymarch hides in the underworld's western cavern.

items.name: Leviathan

route.why: The king fights only after his queen approves of you

items.notes: Lightning is his weakness; Reflect his Tsunami if you can.

items.name: Odin
items.notes: The late king's ghost. Strike before he raises his sword — lightning helps.

items.name: Bahamut
items.location: Lair of the Father, the moon

route.why: The Hallowed Father's cave is open the moment you land

items.notes: Count his Mega Flare timer and mirror it with Reflect.

items.name: Rat Tail

route.why: The oddest chest in the underworld starts the Excalibur chain

items.notes: In the Passage of the Eidolons' treasure room.

items.name: Adamantite
items.notes: The tail collector on the northeast isle trades Rat Tail for Adamantite. Reach him with the hovercraft carried by the Big Whale.

items.name: Excalibur
steps: Hand Kokkol the Adamantite (with the Legend Sword in the party)
Advance the story a beat while he works
Return to the forge for the Excalibur

route.why: Hand Kokkol the adamantite and the legendary sword gets reforged

items.notes: Return after a story beat to collect the finished blade for Cecil.

items.name: Lunar Subterrane legendary gear
items.notes: Ragnarok, Murasame, the Masamune, Crystal Mail, the dragon set — each guarded by a chest fight that earns its reputation.

items.name: Pink Tail
items.notes: Flan Princesses in the pink-flan room drop it at roughly 1/64. The grind is the price of the best armor in the game.

items.name: Adamant Armor
items.notes: The tail collector's other trade. Wearable by anyone; wasted on no one.

items.name: Dark Matter
items.notes: Steal from Zeromus itself (GBA/PSP/Pixel Remaster). A trophy stolen from the end of the world.
